h.en: 2.1.1 Classification and selection of joining methods

body.en:
Joining may be temporary/detachable (bolts/screws) or permanent (many welded, brazed, soldered, riveted or adhesive joints). Fusion welding locally melts the base metal; solid-state welding joins without bulk melting, under suitable pressure/energy conditions. Pressure and fusion classifications can overlap for some methods.

Choose by base-metal compatibility, thickness, access, load, joint design, heat distortion, production rate and inspection needs. Weldability is not the same as melting point. A sound joint also needs preparation, correct consumables and a qualified procedure.
body.gu:
Joining temporary/detachable જેમ bolts અથવા permanent જેમ weld,brazed,soldered,riveted હોઈ શકે. Fusion welding base metal melt કરે;solid-state suitable pressure/energy સાથે bulk melting વગર. કેટલાક methods માં classifications overlap.

Material,thickness,access,load,joint design,distortion,quantity,inspection મુજબ selection. Weldability માત્ર melting point નથી;preparation,consumables,qualified procedure પણ જરૂરી.

title.en: 2.2 Arc welding: detailed equipment and working
title.gu: 2.2 Arc Welding: Detailed Equipment અને Working

h.en: 2.2.1 Metal arc / shielded metal arc welding (SMAW)

body.en:
An arc between a flux-coated consumable electrode and the work melts the joint and electrode. Flux produces protective gas/slag.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A rated AC or DC welding power source provides the required current characteristic and controls.
  2. Insulated electrode and work-return leads complete the circuit; the work return is not a substitute for protective earthing.
  3. An electrode holder grips the coated electrode and carries current without exposing the operator to bare conductive parts.
  4. The consumable core wire supplies filler; its flux coating stabilises the arc and provides shielding/slag according to classification.
  5. Prepared work edges, tack welds and fixtures maintain joint gap/alignment while allowing for shrinkage.
  6. Suitable screens, local extraction, helmet/filter and other PPE protect against arc radiation, fumes and spatter.
  7. Cleaning and inspection tools remove slag between passes and check bead quality after safe cooling.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Confirm compatible base material, electrode classification, joint preparation and authorised welding procedure.
  2. Secure/align the work, connect the return correctly and check electrical, extraction and screen protection.
  3. Establish the arc by the approved technique and maintain the specified arc length, angle and current condition.
  4. Arc heat melts the edges and electrode tip; droplets enter the protected weld pool.
  5. Move along the joint with controlled travel so the pool fuses both sides and deposits the required bead.
  6. As the bead solidifies, the slag cover protects it; remove slag safely before another pass when required.
  7. Finish by the procedure, allow safe cooling and inspect profile, fusion indications and specified acceptance requirements.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Coated electrodes are the main consumable. Portable, versatile and useful for fabrication/repair; electrode changes, slag removal, skill dependence and fumes limit productivity. Electrode storage/drying follows manufacturer requirements, not arbitrary heating.
body.gu:
Flux-coated consumable electrode અને work વચ્ચે arc joint/electrode melt કરે;flux gas/slag protection આપે.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Rated AC/DC source required current characteristic/control આપે.
  2. Insulated electrode/work-return leads circuit પૂર્ણ કરે;return protective earth નથી.
  3. Holder coated electrode grip/current આપે અને exposed conductor contact ઘટાડે.
  4. Core wire filler આપે;classified flux coating arc stability અને shielding/slag આપે.
  5. Prepared edges,tacks,fixtures gap/alignment જાળવે અને shrinkage વિચારવામાં આવે.
  6. Screens,extraction,proper filter/PPE radiation,fumes,spatter માટે.
  7. Cleaning/inspection tools safe cooling પછી slag/interpass અને bead તપાસે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Compatible base material,electrode,joint અને authorised procedure verify કરો.
  2. Work secure/align,return connect અને electrical/extraction/screens check કરો.
  3. Approved technique થી arc establish;specified length,angle,current condition રાખો.
  4. Arc edges/electrode melt કરે;droplets protected pool માં મળે.
  5. Controlled travel થી બંને sides fusion અને required bead બને.
  6. Bead solidify થાય ત્યારે slag protect કરે;next pass પહેલાં safely slag કાઢો.
  7. Procedure પ્રમાણે finish,cool અને profile/fusion/acceptance inspect કરો.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Consumable coated electrode. Portable/versatile fabrication/repair માટે;electrode changes,slag,skill,fumes મર્યાદા. Storage/drying manufacturer મુજબ.

body.en:
A continuously fed consumable wire forms an arc with the work; external shielding gas protects the pool. MIG uses inert gas; active-gas variants are called MAG, both within GMAW.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A compatible welding source supplies controlled electrical power, commonly with a constant-voltage characteristic.
  2. A wire spool and driven feed rollers deliver the selected electrode continuously at a controlled feed rate.
  3. The gun contains liner, contact tip and nozzle; the tip transfers current and the nozzle directs shielding gas.
  4. A suitable shielding-gas supply, regulator/flow control and hose provide the specified gas mixture.
  5. Work-return lead, fixtures and prepared joint complete the electrical path and maintain fit-up.
  6. The selected wire composition/diameter and gas must match alloy, transfer mode and qualified procedure.
  7. Extraction, screens and guarding protect against fumes, radiation, moving wire and hot spatter.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Check material, joint, wire and gas compatibility and the authorised operating programme.
  2. Prepare/fixture the joint and verify the return connection, feed path and shielding system.
  3. Initiate the controlled wire feed, gas shielding and arc through the gun according to procedure.
  4. Wire melts into the pool while arc heat fuses the prepared base-metal edges.
  5. Gun travel maintains bead placement and shielding; drafts can disturb protection and cause porosity.
  6. Complete the bead using the designed termination/crater practice and allow the hot joint to cool safely.
  7. Inspect bead, spatter and acceptance requirements; maintain feed rollers/tip only after prescribed isolation.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Wire and gas are consumed. High deposition and easy automation suit sheet/fabrication/production; equipment cost, wind sensitivity and setup dependence are limitations. Gas cylinders require secured storage and approved handling.
body.gu:
Continuous wire/work વચ્ચે arc અને external gas shielding. Inert gas=MIG;active gas=MAG;બંને GMAW family.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Compatible source controlled power આપે,commonly constant-voltage.
  2. Spool/drive rollers selected wire controlled rate થી feed કરે.
  3. Gun liner,contact tip,nozzle;tip current અને nozzle gas આપે.
  4. Suitable gas supply/regulator/flow/hose specified mix આપે.
  5. Return,fixtures,joint preparation circuit/fit-up જાળવે.
  6. Wire chemistry/diameter અને gas alloy,transfer mode,procedure સાથે match.
  7. Extraction/screens/guards fumes,radiation,moving wire,spatter માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Material,joint,wire,gas અને authorised programme check.
  2. Joint prepare/fixture;return,feed path,shielding verify.
  3. Procedure મુજબ wire,gas,arc gun થી initiate.
  4. Wire pool માં melt અને arc base edges fuse કરે.
  5. Travel bead/shielding જાળવે;drafts gas disturb કરી porosity આપી શકે.
  6. Designed termination/crater practice પછી safely cool.
  7. Bead/spatter/acceptance inspect;feed/tip maintenance isolation પછી.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Wire/gas consumables. High deposition/automation production માટે;cost,wind sensitivity,setup dependence મર્યાદા. Cylinders secure/approved handling જરૂરી.

body.en:
A non-consumable tungsten electrode forms the arc; inert gas shields the pool. Separate filler may be added when required.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A suitable current-controlled AC/DC source supplies the polarity/waveform required by the alloy and procedure.
  2. The torch holds the tungsten through a collet and directs gas through a ceramic cup.
  3. Tungsten type, tip preparation and electrode size are selected without assuming one shape suits every waveform.
  4. An inert-gas cylinder, regulator and flow system maintain protection; backing shielding may be specified for the root.
  5. A separate compatible filler rod/wire supplies metal when autogenous welding is unsuitable.
  6. A return lead and clean fixtures support the joint; torch cooling may be air or an engineered liquid circuit.
  7. Controls, extraction and arc PPE protect the operator; some torch/cooling layouts require additional interlocks.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Clean oxide/contamination by an alloy-appropriate method and establish precise fit-up.
  2. Confirm tungsten, filler, gas and electrical programme match the approved procedure.
  3. Establish gas protection and initiate the arc without contaminating the electrode/work.
  4. Arc heat creates a small controlled pool while tungsten normally remains unmelted.
  5. Add filler to the pool as required, maintaining shielding and avoiding tungsten contact with molten filler.
  6. Travel/terminate according to procedure and retain specified shielding during cooling.
  7. Inspect profile, cleanliness and acceptance; replace/reprepare contaminated tungsten by approved practice.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Gas and optional filler are consumed; tungsten wears but is not intended as deposited filler. Excellent control/clean welds suit stainless steel and aluminium; slower deposition, cleanliness and skill are limitations.
body.gu:
Non-consumable tungsten arc બનાવે;inert gas shield કરે. જરૂર પડે તો separate filler ઉમેરાય.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Suitable AC/DC current-controlled source alloy/procedure મુજબ polarity/waveform આપે.
  2. Torch collet tungsten hold અને ceramic cup gas direct કરે.
  3. Tungsten type,tip,size waveform મુજબ;એક shape universal નહિ.
  4. Inert gas supply/flow protection;root માટે backing shielding specified હોઈ શકે.
  5. Autogenous welding unsuitable હોય તો compatible separate filler.
  6. Return/clean fixtures joint support;torch air અથવા engineered liquid cooling.
  7. Controls,extraction,arc PPE;કેટલાક layouts માં additional interlocks.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Alloy-appropriate cleaning અને precise fit-up કરો.
  2. Tungsten,filler,gas,electrical programme procedure સાથે match.
  3. Gas protection પછી electrode/work contaminate કર્યા વગર arc initiate.
  4. Arc controlled pool બનાવે;tungsten normally unmelted રહે.
  5. જરૂર મુજબ filler ઉમેરો;shielding અને tungsten contact avoidance રાખો.
  6. Procedure મુજબ travel/terminate અને specified cooling shielding રાખો.
  7. Profile/cleanliness inspect;contaminated tungsten approved રીતે reprepare.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Gas/optional filler consumed;tungsten wear થાય પણ filler તરીકે deposit કરવા માટે નથી. Stainless/aluminium precision માટે;speed,cleanliness,skill મર્યાદા.

body.en:
The arc burns beneath a granular flux blanket, not beneath water. Continuous wire and flux shield the pool.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A rated high-duty welding source provides controlled power for the selected wire/flux combination.
  2. A continuous electrode feeder and contact assembly deliver wire into the joint.
  3. A flux hopper meters suitable dry granular flux over the weld path.
  4. A travel carriage or work-moving system maintains consistent relative motion along the seam.
  5. Prepared edges, support/backing where specified and fixtures control gap and alignment.
  6. Flux recovery equipment may reclaim only uncontaminated reusable material under the applicable specification.
  7. Return leads, guarding, extraction and slag-handling tools complete the protected installation.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Prepare the joint and verify approved wire/flux, backing, alignment and programme.
  2. Position the head and establish a sufficient controlled flux cover ahead of the arc.
  3. Initiate wire feed and arc beneath the blanket through the authorised automatic sequence.
  4. Arc heat fuses base and wire; some flux forms protective molten slag while the blanket screens the arc.
  5. Travel along the seam maintains the pool and deposition; geometry limits suitable welding positions.
  6. After solidification/cooling, remove slag and recover usable unfused flux by the approved route.
  7. Inspect the seam and verify acceptance, including internal soundness when specified.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Consumables are wire and classified flux. High deposition and consistent long seams suit vessels/structures; generally flat/horizontal-fillet use, setup cost and limited access are disadvantages. Hidden arc does not eliminate electrical/fume hazards.
body.gu:
Arc granular flux નીચે હોય,water નીચે નહિ. Continuous wire/flux pool protect કરે.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Rated high-duty source selected wire/flux માટે power આપે.
  2. Feeder/contact assembly joint માં wire આપે.
  3. Hopper suitable dry granular flux weld path પર આપે.
  4. Carriage/work motion seam પર consistent relative travel આપે.
  5. Prepared edges,specified support/backing,fixtures gap/alignment રાખે.
  6. Recovery ફક્ત specification મુજબ clean reusable flux માટે.
  7. Return,guards,extraction,slag tools protected setup પૂર્ણ કરે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Joint,wire/flux,backing,alignment,programme verify.
  2. Head position અને controlled flux cover establish.
  3. Authorised sequence થી flux નીચે wire/arc initiate.
  4. Arc base/wire fuse;flux slag બને અને blanket arc screen કરે.
  5. Seam travel deposition જાળવે;geometry positions limit કરે.
  6. Solidify/cool પછી slag અને reusable unfused flux approved રીતે અલગ.
  7. Seam/acceptance અને specified internal soundness inspect.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Wire/classified flux consumables. High deposition,long seams માટે;flat/horizontal-fillet limits,cost,access મર્યાદા. Hidden arc એટલે electrical/fume hazard zero નહિ.

body.en:
Combustion heat melts the joint and compatible filler; no electrical arc is required. This is an equipment explanation, not a cylinder-lighting procedure.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Separate approved oxygen and acetylene cylinders/manifolds supply the gases; cylinders are secured and handled by trained staff.
  2. Gas-specific regulators and gauges reduce supply pressure through rated components.
  3. Compatible identified hoses keep oxygen and fuel paths separate until the torch mixer.
  4. Non-return devices and suitable flashback protection are installed as the equipment standard requires.
  5. A welding torch contains control valves, mixer and the correct welding tip.
  6. Compatible filler and required flux support the selected base-metal joint.
  7. Fixtures, ventilation, fire control and suitable gas-welding eye/PPE protection complete the station.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Authorised personnel inspect equipment, gas compatibility, leak-test status and the approved welding plan.
  2. Clean/prepare and align the joint; select compatible filler/flux and tip by procedure.
  3. The trained operator establishes the specified stable flame using the approved manufacturer sequence.
  4. Flame heat brings the joint edges to a controlled molten condition.
  5. Filler is introduced where required while the torch travels and maintains fusion.
  6. The bead solidifies as heat moves on; avoid unsupported assumptions about cooling or quenching.
  7. Finish/shut down by the authorised sequence, make the area safe and inspect the cooled joint.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Oxygen, acetylene, filler and sometimes flux are consumed. Portable heat control suits thin-sheet/repair work, but heat spread, distortion, speed and fire risks limit use. Oxygen equipment must remain free of oil/grease.
body.gu:
Combustion heat joint/filler melt કરે;electrical arc નહિ. આ equipment explanation છે,cylinder-lighting procedure નથી.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Approved oxygen/acetylene cylinders secured હોય;trained handling જરૂરી.
  2. Gas-specific regulators/gauges rated રીતે pressure reduce કરે.
  3. Compatible identified hoses mixer સુધી gases અલગ રાખે.
  4. Standard મુજબ non-return/flashback protection હોય.
  5. Torch માં valves,mixer,correct welding tip હોય.
  6. Compatible filler/required flux joint માટે.
  7. Fixtures,ventilation,fire controls,proper gas-welding PPE station પૂરું કરે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Authorised staff equipment,compatibility,leak-test status,plan check કરે.
  2. Joint clean/prepare/align;procedure મુજબ filler/flux/tip.
  3. Trained operator approved sequence થી specified stable flame બનાવે.
  4. Flame joint edges ને controlled molten condition સુધી ગરમ કરે.
  5. જરૂર મુજબ filler અને controlled torch travel થી fusion.
  6. Heat આગળ જતાં bead solidify;arbitrary quenching નહિ.
  7. Authorised finish/shutdown,area safe અને cooled joint inspect.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Gases,filler,ક્યારેક flux consumables. Thin sheet/repair માટે heat control;distortion,speed,fire risk મર્યાદા. Oxygen fittings oil/grease-free રહે.

body.en:
Neutral flame has approximately balanced oxygen/fuel supply for its intended combustion and a distinct inner cone; it is commonly selected for many welding duties. Carburising/reducing flame has excess acetylene and an acetylene feather, which can alter metal chemistry. Oxidising flame has excess oxygen, a shorter sharper cone and can oxidise unsuitable alloys.

Select the flame by alloy and qualified procedure, not colour alone or an assumed universal regulator ratio. A reducing flame is not automatically correct for all metals; an oxidising flame is not simply a hotter replacement.
body.gu:
Neutral flame માં intended combustion માટે balanced supply અને distinct cone;ઘણા welding duties માં. Carburising માં excess acetylene/feather chemistry બદલી શકે. Oxidising માં excess oxygen,short sharp cone અને oxidation risk.

Alloy/procedure મુજબ selection;colour/regulator universal ratio પરથી નહિ. Reducing દરેક metal માટે correct નહિ;oxidising ફક્ત hotter replacement નથી.

body.en:
Preheat raises suitable steel to ignition conditions; a separate oxygen jet oxidises it and expels reaction products through the kerf. It is not merely melting by a welding flame.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Approved oxygen/fuel supplies and gas-specific regulators provide controlled gases.
  2. Protected hoses, check devices and flashback protection follow the equipment standard.
  3. A cutting torch contains preheat passages plus a separate cutting-oxygen valve/passage.
  4. The cutting tip directs surrounding preheat flames and a central oxygen jet.
  5. A guided/manual traverse supports the torch along the marked cut with adequate clearance underneath.
  6. Supports hold the plate and prevent the cut piece dropping uncontrollably.
  7. Extraction, fire-safe screens and suitable PPE control fumes, hot slag and radiation.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Confirm material is suitable; conventional oxy-fuel cutting is not universal for stainless steel or aluminium.
  2. Prepare/support the work and clear slag path, combustibles and personnel from the cut zone.
  3. The trained operator establishes specified preheat under an approved torch procedure.
  4. Preheat brings the starting region to the condition needed for rapid oxygen reaction.
  5. The controlled cutting jet oxidises metal and clears the kerf while traverse advances the cut.
  6. Maintain approved travel/clearance and support the separated piece; never catch it by hand.
  7. Complete safe shutdown, cool/handle by procedure and inspect kerf, dross and cut squareness.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Suits many carbon/low-alloy steels, especially plate profiles; broad heat-affected zones and unsuitable alloy oxidation behaviour limit it. No gas-pressure, lighting or emergency-valve sequence is prescribed here.
body.gu:
Preheat suitable steel ને ignition condition આપે;separate oxygen jet oxidise કરી products kerf માંથી કાઢે. ફક્ત welding flame થી melting નથી.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Approved gas supplies/regulators controlled gases આપે.
  2. Hoses/check/flashback protection standard મુજબ.
  3. Cutting torch માં preheat passages અને separate cutting-oxygen passage.
  4. Tip surrounding preheat flames/central oxygen jet આપે.
  5. Guide/manual traverse marked line અને below-clearance જાળવે.
  6. Supports plate/cut piece uncontrolled fall અટકાવે.
  7. Extraction/fire screens/PPE fumes,slag,radiation માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Material suitability check;stainless/aluminium માટે conventional method universal નહિ.
  2. Work/support/slag path clear;combustibles/persons દૂર.
  3. Trained operator approved procedure થી preheat બનાવે.
  4. Starting region rapid oxidation માટે જરૂરી condition સુધી આવે.
  5. Cutting jet oxidation/kerf clearing સાથે travel કરે.
  6. Approved travel/clearance/support;hot piece હાથથી catch નહિ.
  7. Safe shutdown/cooling/handling પછી kerf,dross,squareness inspect.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

ઘણા carbon/low-alloy steel plate માટે;HAZ અને alloy oxidation limits. અહીં pressure,lighting,emergency-valve operating sequence નથી.

h.en: 2.3.4 Resistance spot welding: setup and working
h.gu: 2.3.4 Resistance Spot Welding: Setup અને Working

body.en:
Clamping force and timed high current generate interface heat (Q≈I²Rt). Overlapping sheets form a local nugget without a consumable filler electrode.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A low-voltage high-current supply/transformer delivers the controlled welding current.
  2. Opposed copper-alloy electrode tips contact the outside sheet surfaces.
  3. A force actuator and rigid arms apply repeatable squeeze and hold loads.
  4. Electrode holders and rated cooling circuits remove heat from the tooling.
  5. Timer/controller sequences squeeze, current and hold rather than treating them as one uncontrolled event.
  6. Overlap fixtures maintain position and access to both sides of the joint.
  7. Guards/interlocks, isolation and tip-maintenance provisions address crushing, current and expelled metal hazards.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Confirm sheet material/thickness, surface condition and the approved spot schedule.
  2. Locate the overlapping sheets with proper contact and electrode alignment.
  3. Electrodes squeeze the sheets before current flows to establish the designed contact condition.
  4. The timed current heats the interface and forms a molten nugget within the constrained region.
  5. Current stops while force remains during hold so the nugget solidifies.
  6. Electrodes release and the work moves only after the controller permits safe handling.
  7. Inspect indentation and specified weld tests; external appearance alone does not prove nugget size/strength.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Fast sheet assembly and no separate filler suit vehicle/body fabrication. Two-side access, overlap geometry, thickness/material range and electrode wear are limits. Seam welding uses rotating wheel electrodes for successive overlapping welds; its demonstration is listed in the practical scope, but detailed theory here is spot setup/working.
body.gu:
Force અને timed high current interface heat આપે(Q≈I²Rt);overlap sheets માં nugget,consumable filler electrode નહિ.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. Low-voltage high-current source controlled current આપે.
  2. Opposed copper-alloy tips outer surfaces touch કરે.
  3. Actuator/rigid arms repeatable squeeze/hold force આપે.
  4. Holders/rated cooling tooling heat દૂર કરે.
  5. Controller squeeze,current,hold અલગ timed stages રાખે.
  6. Fixtures overlap/location અને બંને sides access આપે.
  7. Guards/isolation/tip maintenance crush,current,expulsion hazards માટે.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Sheet/thickness/surface/approved schedule verify.
  2. Sheets overlap અને electrodes align કરો.
  3. Current પહેલાં electrodes squeeze કરી contact establish કરે.
  4. Timed current interface heat/nugget બનાવે.
  5. Current બંધ પછી hold force હેઠળ nugget solidify.
  6. Controller permit પછી release/work movement.
  7. Indentation/specified tests inspect;appearance એકલું strength proof નહિ.

Consumables, applications, merits અને limitations

Fast sheet assembly/no filler લાભ;two-side access,overlap,range,tip wear મર્યાદા. Seam માં wheel electrodes successive welds આપે;practicalમાં listed,અહીં theory spot setup/working.

body.en:
An exothermic aluminothermic reaction generates heat and molten weld metal in a refractory system. This is a specialist process, not a mixture recipe for a student experiment.

Construction / equipment — 7 points

  1. A prepared aligned joint/gap is held by suitable rail fixtures.
  2. A dry refractory mould surrounds the joint and provides cavity and overflow/feeding provisions.
  3. A refractory crucible contains the approved proprietary reaction charge.
  4. A designed separation/tapping path delivers weld metal while controlling slag carryover.
  5. An approved preheat arrangement conditions the joint/mould where the qualified system requires it.
  6. Rated containment, exclusion barriers and handling equipment protect against intense heat and reaction products.
  7. Trimming/grinding and inspection equipment finish the joint after the specified cooling stage.

Working — 7 steps

  1. Qualified personnel prepare and align the rail ends to the approved joint specification.
  2. Install the correct dry mould and inspect sealing/support without introducing moisture.
  3. Condition/preheat as the proprietary qualified procedure requires.
  4. Only trained authorised personnel initiate the approved reaction system within its exclusion zone.
  5. The process produces molten weld metal, which enters the mould through the controlled delivery path.
  6. The joint solidifies and cools for the specified stage before mould removal and finishing.
  7. Trim/grind and inspect alignment, profile and specified internal/acceptance requirements.

Consumables, applications, merits and limitations

Useful for field rail and selected heavy-section joints without a conventional arc source. Portable energy generation is an advantage; one-shot control, consumable moulds, stringent alignment and extreme thermal hazards are limits. No charge proportions or ignition instructions are included.

body.en:
Five basic arrangements are butt, lap, T, corner and edge. The weld form may be fillet, groove or another design; a T-joint commonly uses fillets while a butt joint often uses a groove, but the words are not interchangeable.

Joint preparation controls root gap, groove angle, land, accessibility and penetration. Choose by load path, thickness, distortion, inspection and process access. A larger bead is not automatically stronger if it creates lack of fusion, high stress concentration or excessive heat input.

body.en:
1. Identify base metals, service temperature and a compatible approved filler/flux system.
  2. Clean the joining surfaces to remove contamination and oxide by the suitable method.
  3. Fit and support the joint with the specified clearance/contact area.
  4. Apply flux where required and heat with suitable controlled equipment.
  5. Introduce filler so it wets the base surfaces; the base metal must remain solid.
  6. Remove heat and hold alignment during solidification without disturbing the joint.
  7. Clean residual flux where required and inspect wetting, continuity and application-specific acceptance.

By the conventional filler-liquidus boundary, soldering uses filler below450°C. Electronics, electrical connections and light sheet joints are applications. Service-temperature/strength limits and flux residues matter; use lead-free or other specified approved alloys and fume controls.

  6. Heat દૂર કરી solidification દરમિયાન alignment રાખો.
  7. Required flux cleaning પછી wetting/continuity/acceptance inspect.

body.en:
1. Select compatible base metals, brazing filler and flux/protective atmosphere by the service requirement.
  2. Clean surfaces thoroughly; filler cannot reliably wet heavy oxide or grease.
  3. Fit the joint with designed capillary clearance and suitable overlapping area/support.
  4. Apply specified flux/protection and heat the assembly uniformly by the approved method.
  5. Melt the filler above its liquidus so capillary action draws it through the gap while base metal remains solid.
  6. Allow controlled solidification/cooling while maintaining alignment and avoiding unsuitable quenching.
  7. Remove required residues and inspect fill, leakage/strength requirements and base-metal heat effects.

Brazing filler has liquidus above450°C but below the base-metal solidus. Carbide tool tips, heat exchangers and suitable dissimilar-metal joints are applications. Good fit-up and cleanliness are essential; high service temperatures can weaken the filler joint.

  3. Designed capillary gap/overlap/support સાથે fit.
  4. Specified flux/protection/approved uniform heat.
  5. Filler liquidus ઉપર melt/capillary gap ભરે;base solid રહે.
  6. Alignment રાખી controlled solidify/cool;unsuitable quench નહિ.
  7. Residue clean અને fill,leak/strength,heat effects inspect.

body.en:
Fusion welding melts the base edges; solid-state welding is an important exception to the statement that all welding melts base metal. Brazing/soldering melt only a lower-melting filler and rely on wetting/joint design. The450°C convention distinguishes brazing from soldering by filler liquidus, not by a universal machine setpoint.

Welded joints can carry high loads with suitable metallurgy; brazed lap area can give strong dissimilar joints; soldering suits lower thermal/mechanical duties. All require compatibility and process control. Never rank their strength without specifying material, geometry and service conditions.

Fusion welding base melt કરે;solid-state exception છે. Brazing/soldering lower-melting filler,wetting,joint design પર આધારિત.450°C filler-liquidus convention છે,machine setpoint નહિ.

Suitable welding high loads,brazed lap dissimilar joints,solder lower thermal/mechanical duties માટે. Material,geometry,service વગર strength ranking નહિ.

body.en:
Control arc UV/IR, hot metal, electrical shock, fumes, gas pressure/fire and confined-space hazards with rated equipment, extraction, screens, PPE and authorised isolation. Secure cylinders, keep oxygen equipment oil-free and follow the site hot-work permit/fire-watch procedure. Never weld a sealed or unknown container. Confined-space work needs a dedicated assessment/rescue plan, not simply a fan.

Porosity may indicate contamination/gas shielding problems; lack of fusion/penetration may reflect preparation or heat/travel; cracks require metallurgy/restraint analysis; slag inclusions require cleaning/technique correction. Use visual and specified tests; do not assume an attractive bead proves internal soundness.

Arc radiation,heat,shock,fumes,gas/fire/confined-space hazards માટે rated equipment,extraction,screens,PPE,isolation. Cylinders secure,oxygen oil-free,hot-work permit/fire watch. Sealed/unknown container weld નહિ. Confined-space dedicated assessment/rescue જરૂરી.

Porosity contamination/shielding;fusion defects preparation/heat/travel;cracks metallurgy/restraint;slag cleaning/technique તપાસો. Attractive bead internal soundness proof નથી.
